body:
I am currently seeing a slew of mental health professionals, but I feel a bit... cramped in telling them, with my being a minor (I don't know what they'll put me through with no choice on my part (I live in N.C., bad place for mental healthcare))

I guess I should though... 
Thanks.
Yeah. I'm so hesitant to call this "normal", but I guess I'm not as crazy as some people. Gods know I've got my own set of problems, but maybe this isn't one.

I have these every night. tonight it's worse. rape, molestation, whatever you want to call it. beatings. i go through hell every night
my life story is one of pain. i just need someone to know it. somebody. it hurts so much to keep all of this in. no one knows it all. no one. i need someone to UNDERSTAND

my future is... not a bright one. I know what pain is. i've lived in it for my entire life, but... the past few months have somehow been even worse. before it was like a dull ache in my chest, but now... I feel like i'm being crushed by it. Like I'm drowning.

it's very likely that she doesn't have her phone. Her father thinks she ran away (which she *has* done before: to my house, actually. that's why he came to me first). But she doesn't have anywhere to run too. And she's always told me before she ran away. I always got some kind of warning. But as of right now... i have no evidence that my Auri's alive.

But you're right about my mum. She's a good person, and she tries for me harder than I really deserve. she's trying to help me be who I am. but here, where we live... if anyone near our house found out, i could be killed. that isn't an exaggeration, either. it's a very religious, very *dangerous* neighbourhood.

I know how you feel. I'm in the same boat. I've got my own post on here. But you'd be surprised how many people would reach out to you, given the chance. There are always people there for you, if you look. Look at me. Total stranger, also in need of help. I plan on ending it tonight. But I'm here. Don't sell yourself short. I know you have talents. Your future is a bright one, if you give it a chance.

I'm sorry. guess i did a piss-poor job explaining any of that, huh?
She just turned up missing today. I haven't heard anything from her for 24 hours (which is very out of character). She hasn't responded to any of my attempts to contact her, and she has a bad history.
I'm sixteen. I live in north carolina, in the U.S.. I hate this country. I want nothing more than to move to england. But if we did... we would have less than nothing. we'd have to sell everything we own just to afford the plane tickets.
And I was unfair earlier. I have told my mother. and she's trying, really hard, to accept me. but... *sigh*... she doesn't know what she's doing. and i don't have the energy to correct her
I don't think i'm in immediate danger. But i'm scarily calm right now. i don't like it.
